Meet Tommy

Our Story

Tommy

IDC Nails is a small shop in Suite C at 354 S Main St, Slippery Rock, PA. It opened in October 2024 and is run by owner Tommy and his wife.

Services are custom designs and personalized manicures and pedicures, with acrylic nails, nail art, coffin nails, long nails, natural nails, black tip nails, and pride nails. Appointments are set by DM, per the shop's own description.
